name: Misterbianco (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Misterbianco (a black eagle with a bend on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Misterbianco, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Misterbianco arms — black eagle with a bend on white, crowned, within branches
